backlog.spec: Replace the binary Morgan bit vector with count-based fingerprints using gen.GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy (radius 2, 2048 bits). Keep the RF unchanged. Counts carry more information about substructure multiplicity.
backlog.title: Count Morgan fingerprints

backlog.spec: Append all RDKit Descriptors.descList values (about 210) to the Morgan features. Convert NaN and inf to 0 and clip extreme values to +/-1e6. Keep the RF. Logp, TPSA and similar descriptors matter for clearance.
backlog.title: RDKit 2D descriptors added

backlog.spec: Use only RDKit descriptors (clean NaN/inf, clip) as RF features, with no fingerprints. Set max_features=0.33.
backlog.title: Descriptors only RF

backlog.spec: Build features from RDKit descriptors plus count Morgan radius 2 with 1024 bits. Train LGBMRegressor with n_estimators=500, learning_rate=0.03, num_leaves=15, subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1, colsample_bytree=0.3, min_child_samples=10, random_state=seed, verbose=-1.
backlog.title: LightGBM on descriptors+counts

backlog.spec: Use RDKit descriptors plus MACCS keys as features. Fit CatBoostRegressor with iterations=800, depth=6, learning_rate=0.03, random_seed=seed, thread_count=8, verbose=0.
backlog.title: CatBoost on descriptors

backlog.spec: Concatenate the 167 MACCS keys (rdkit.Chem.MACCSkeys.GenMACCSKeys) to the Morgan bits and fit the RF.
backlog.title: MACCS keys addition

backlog.spec: Convert train_y to normalized ranks (scipy.stats.rankdata/len) before fitting. The loss is Spearman, so this removes outlier influence. Predictions are used as-is.
backlog.title: Rank-transform target

backlog.spec: Set N_TREES=1000, MIN_SAMPLES_LEAF=2, MAX_FEATURES=0.2. This reduces variance.
backlog.title: Larger RF, min leaf 2

backlog.spec: Replace the RF with ExtraTreesRegressor (n_estimators=800, max_features=0.3, min_samples_leaf=2, n_jobs=-1) on Morgan counts plus RDKit descriptors.
backlog.title: ExtraTrees on descriptors+FP

backlog.spec: Concatenate count atom-pair fingerprints (GetAtomPairGenerator, fpSize 1024) and topological torsion counts (fpSize 1024) with Morgan counts. Use the RF.
backlog.title: Atom-pair and torsion count FPs

backlog.spec: Use Morgan counts with radius 3 and 4096 bits, plus FCFP-style invariants (atomInvariantsGenerator=GetMorganFeatureAtomInvGen). Concatenate both. Use the RF.
backlog.title: Feature-based Morgan radius 3 folded counts

backlog.spec: Compute the Tanimoto kernel on binary Morgan r2 2048 bits between test and train, and between train and train. Fit sklearn SVR(kernel='precomputed', C=5, epsilon=0.1) on the rank-transformed target.
backlog.title: Tanimoto-kernel SVR

backlog.spec: Use KernelRidge with a precomputed MinMax kernel on Morgan count fingerprints (radius 2). Set alpha=1.0. Predict with the kernel between test and train.
backlog.title: Tanimoto kernel ridge/GP

backlog.spec: Fit an RF, an LGBM, and a Tanimoto SVR on the same features. Rank-normalize each model's test predictions and average them. This reduces model variance.
backlog.title: Ensemble RF + LGBM + SVR rank average

backlog.spec: Fit 5 LGBMRegressor models with different seeds, objective='huber', on descriptors. Average the predictions. Use learning_rate=0.03, 400 trees, num_leaves=8.
backlog.title: Seed-bagged LGBM with huber loss

backlog.spec: Drop fingerprint bits that are on in fewer than 5 training molecules or in more than 95 percent of them. Then fit the RF with max_features=0.3. This reduces noise.
backlog.title: Variance filter and feature selection

backlog.spec: Add rdMolDescriptors.MQNs_ (42 values), the EState fingerprint sums (FingerprintMol), and Crippen per-atom contributions summed by type. Use these with Morgan counts in the RF.
backlog.title: Crippen/EState/MQN features

backlog.spec: Fit XGBRegressor on descriptors plus Morgan counts at 1024 bits. Set n_estimators=600, max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.03, subsample=0.8, colsample_bytree=0.3, reg_lambda=5, n_jobs=8, random_state=seed.
backlog.title: XGBoost with descriptors+counts

backlog.spec: Standardize the target with a quantile transform to a normal distribution (sklearn QuantileTransformer, output_distribution='normal'). Fit the RF on it. The gaussian target may help tree splits.
backlog.title: Log-transform check on target

backlog.spec: Use descriptors plus Morgan counts with RF max_features='sqrt', min_samples_leaf=1, 500 trees. This is a more decorrelated forest.
backlog.title: RF max_features sqrt on mixed features

backlog.spec: Compute Murcko scaffolds for the training set. Weight each molecule by 1/sqrt(size of its scaffold group) in RF fit(sample_weight=...). This reduces dominance by large scaffold series.
backlog.title: Scaffold-aware sample weights

backlog.spec: Standardize the clipped descriptors with QuantileTransformer and fit 5 sklearn MLPRegressor models (hidden 256,64, alpha=1e-2, early_stopping, different seeds). Average the predictions.
backlog.title: Small MLP ensemble on descriptors

backlog.spec: Within fit_predict, make 5-fold out-of-fold predictions from RF, LGBM and SVR. Fit a non-negative LinearRegression (positive=True) on them and apply it to the test predictions of models refit on all data.
backlog.title: Stacked ridge over model predictions

backlog.spec: Winsorize train_y at the 2nd and 98th percentiles before fitting the RF. This limits outlier influence on the squared loss.
backlog.title: Pairwise-rank-friendly target: clip outliers

backlog.spec: Add the rdkit Fragments fr_* counts (about 85 functions) to the Morgan counts and fit the RF.
backlog.title: Ring/functional group counts

backlog.spec: Add the rdMolDescriptors functions CalcNumRings, CalcFractionCSP3, CalcNumRotatableBonds, CalcLabuteASA, CalcTPSA, and the BCUT2D descriptors (rdMolDescriptors.BCUT2D). Combine them with Morgan bits in the RF.
backlog.title: Mordred-like 3D-free shape descriptors

backlog.spec: Before featurizing, keep the largest fragment (rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser) and neutralize charges (Uncharger). Then use the baseline Morgan+RF. This removes counterion noise.
backlog.title: Desalt and canonicalize molecules

backlog.spec: Use CatBoostRegressor with loss_function='RMSE', depth=6, iterations=1000, lr=0.03, l2_leaf_reg=5, rsm=0.2, on rank-transformed y. Features are descriptors plus 1024-bit count Morgan.
backlog.title: CatBoost with Morgan counts and descriptors, ranked target

backlog.spec: Apply TruncatedSVD(64 components) to the count Morgan matrix, concatenate it with the descriptors, and fit the RF with max_features=0.4.
backlog.title: RF on PCA-compressed fingerprints plus descriptors

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, compute the Murcko scaffold of each training molecule (rdkit.Chem.Scaffolds.MurckoScaffold.MurckoScaffoldSmiles). Weight each sample by 1/sqrt(count of its scaffold in the training set), normalized to mean 1. Pass sample_weight to RF.fit, LGBM.fit and SVR.fit. This reduces the influence of large scaffold clusters, which suits a test set of unseen scaffolds.
backlog.title: Scaffold-aware sample weights

backlog.spec: Add a fourth ensemble member: kernel ridge regression (sklearn KernelRidge, kernel='precomputed', alpha=1.0) on the MinMax kernel between Morgan count fingerprints (radius 2, 2048 folded counts). Compute sum(min)/sum(max) with numpy in chunks to limit memory. Fit on the rank target minus its mean. Add its rank-normalized prediction to the rank average.
backlog.title: Tanimoto kernel ridge on count MinMax kernel

backlog.spec: Add a member: sklearn MLPRegressor (hidden 256,64, alpha=1e-2, early_stopping=True, max_iter=300), trained on RDKit descriptors. Before fitting, apply QuantileTransformer(output_distribution='normal') to the descriptors, fit on the training data only. Average 5 seeds derived from `seed`. Add the rank-normalized prediction to the rank-average ensemble.
backlog.title: Small MLP ensemble on scaled descriptors

backlog.spec: Replace the equal-weight np.mean of the three rank predictions with weights of 0.5 for the RF, 0.25 for the LGBM and 0.25 for the SVR. The RF uses descriptors and is the strongest model. Keep everything else unchanged.
backlog.title: Weighted rank ensemble favoring RF

backlog.spec: Change the LightGBM member to train on mixed_features (RDKit descriptors plus Morgan counts) instead of binary bits. Use colsample_bytree=0.2, n_estimators=500, learning_rate=0.02, num_leaves=8, min_child_samples=10, reg_lambda=5. Compute the mixed features once per set and reuse them for the RF.
backlog.title: Descriptor-based LGBM on ranks, replacing fingerprint LGBM

backlog.spec: Replace the plain rank average with a stack. Inside fit_predict, run 5-fold GroupKFold, grouped by Murcko scaffold, to get out-of-fold predictions for each of the three models. Fit a non-negative LinearRegression (positive=True) on the OOF ranks. Refit the base models on all the data and combine their test ranks with the learned weights. Mind the runtime: use fewer RF trees (200) in the inner loop.
backlog.title: Stacked ridge via inner CV

backlog.spec: Extend mixed_features with per-atom-type features. Use rdkit.Chem.EState.Fingerprinter.FingerprintMol (the count and sum vectors), rdMolDescriptors.MQNs_, and the SlogP_VSA, SMR_VSA and PEOE_VSA lists. Concatenate them to the descriptors that feed the RF. This gives the RF more physchem information on lipophilicity and metabolic liability.
backlog.title: Add Crippen contributions, MQN and EState vectors

backlog.spec: Before featurizing, parse each SMILES and keep only the largest fragment (rdkit.Chem.rdmolops.GetMolFrags with asMols=True, choose max by heavy atom count). Optionally neutralize charges with rdMolStandardize.Uncharger. Use the cleaned molecules in featurize and mixed_features. Counterions then no longer distort the descriptors.
backlog.title: Desalt and keep the largest fragment

backlog.spec: Build the SVR kernel as the average of Tanimoto kernels from three fingerprint types: Morgan radius 2 binary, feature-Morgan (FeatureMorgan invariants, radius 3) binary, and atom-pair binary at 2048 bits. Fit SVR on the averaged precomputed kernel. This adds structural views to the kernel while keeping one member.
backlog.title: Multi-radius, feature-invariant Morgan SVR kernel average

backlog.spec: Make the RF member more diverse by averaging 3 RFs. Each RF is trained on a different random 80% subsample, drawn with the seed. Each uses max_features of 0.1, 'sqrt' or 0.3 and min_samples_leaf of 1, 2 or 3. Average their predictions before ranking. This lowers variance without a bigger single forest.
backlog.title: Bagged subsample ensemble with rank-target noise

backlog.spec: In a new helper, parse each SMILES with Chem.MolFromSmiles, split with Chem.GetMolFrags(m, asMols=True), keep the fragment with the most heavy atoms, and use it for both featurize and mixed_features (pass mols instead of re-parsing). Leaves the rest unchanged. Removes counterion noise from fingerprints and descriptors.
backlog.title: Desalt and keep largest fragment

backlog.spec: Replace the single radius-2 binary Tanimoto SVR kernel with the average of Tanimoto kernels computed on binary Morgan fingerprints of radius 1, 2 and 3 (2048 bits each). Keep C=5 and the precomputed SVR on rank targets. The LightGBM member keeps the radius-2 bits.
backlog.title: Multi-radius Tanimoto SVR kernel average

backlog.spec: Replace the equal np.mean of the three rank-normalized predictions with a weighted average using weights RF 0.5, SVR 0.3, LightGBM 0.2. This is fixed, not learned, so there is no inner CV.
backlog.title: Weighted rank ensemble favoring RF

backlog.spec: Extend mixed_features by concatenating rdMolDescriptors.MQNs_(m) (42 values), Crippen per-atom contributions aggregated via rdMolDescriptors.SlogP_VSA_ and SMR_VSA_ and PEOE_VSA_ lists, and EState_VSA/VSA_EState lists from rdkit.Chem.EState. Keep the nan_to_num and clip handling.
backlog.title: Add Crippen, MQN and EState features to RF

backlog.spec: Compute the Tanimoto kernel on binary Morgan bits between all train and test molecules and the training set, then take the top 30 kernel PCA components (sklearn KernelPCA with precomputed kernel, fit on train) and append them to the RF feature matrix. This gives the RF a smooth similarity-based representation.
backlog.title: RF on descriptors with SVR-style kernel PCA features

backlog.spec: Wrap the whole three-model fit/predict in a loop of 5 iterations. Each iteration trains on a random 80% subsample of the training rows, with seed+i, and adds Gaussian noise (sd 0.02) to the rank target. Average the rank-normalized final predictions over the iterations. Watch runtime, which may need RF trees cut to 300.
backlog.title: Subsample bagging of the whole ensemble

backlog.spec: Replace the uniform rank target with a normal-score transform: scipy.stats.norm.ppf of (rank-0.5)/n. This gives tails more weight in the squared-error fits for RF, LightGBM and SVR. Scale the SVR target so its std is about 0.3 and keep C=5.
backlog.title: Clip and winsorize rank target toward a Gaussian

backlog.spec: Add a fourth member that is a kernel ridge or SVR on a sum kernel: 0.5*Tanimoto(Morgan bits) + 0.5*RBF on quantile-transformed, standardized RDKit descriptors, with the gamma set to 1/n_features after dropping zero-variance columns. Use SVR with a precomputed kernel, C=5, on the rank target and add it as a fourth rank-averaged member.
backlog.title: Gaussian process on descriptors plus Tanimoto kernel

backlog.spec: Replace the LightGBM regressor with LGBMRanker (objective lambdarank, a single query group with all training rows). Give the integer relevance labels as the rank target quantized into 30 bins, with label_gain set to linear 0..29. Use the same features and hyperparameters, and rank-normalize its predictions in the ensemble. This directly optimizes ranking.
backlog.title: Pairwise-rank LightGBM using lambdarank

backlog.spec: In fit_predict, before featurizing, standardize every SMILES: parse with RDKit, keep the largest fragment via rdMolStandardize.LargestFragmentChooser().choose(mol) (fall back to the original mol on exception), and use the resulting molecule in featurize and mixed_features (pass Mol objects or re-emit canonical SMILES). Leave models unchanged.
backlog.title: Desalt and keep largest fragment

backlog.spec: Replace the LGBMRegressor with LGBMRanker(objective='lambdarank') trained on one query group containing all training molecules, with integer relevance labels = floor(rank*30) (set label_gain=list(range(31)) or linear gain, lambdarank_truncation_level=len(train)). Keep features, 300 trees, lr 0.03, num_leaves 15, colsample 0.3. Use its predict output in the rank average.
backlog.title: LightGBM lambdarank on rank target

backlog.spec: Add a fourth member: kernel ridge with precomputed kernel K = 0.5*Tanimoto(binary Morgan) + 0.5*exp(-gamma*||z_i-z_j||^2), where z are RDKit descriptors quantile-transformed (QuantileTransformer normal, fit on train), standardized and clipped, gamma=1/(n_features*2). Solve with alpha=0.5 on the rank target (centered), and include its rank-normalized prediction in the average.
backlog.title: Gaussian process on Tanimoto plus descriptor RBF kernel

backlog.spec: Change the target transform from uniform ranks to normal scores: y = scipy.stats.norm.ppf((rank-0.5)/n), clipped to [-2.5, 2.5]. Apply to all three models; final predictions are still rank-averaged.
backlog.title: Winsorized Gaussianized rank target

backlog.spec: Append to the RF features a small set of SMARTS counts relevant to metabolism: ester, amide, carboxylic acid, phenol, aromatic amine, N-methyl, O-methyl, tertiary amine, sulfonamide, halogen on aromatic ring, benzylic CH2, thiophene, furan, plus Crippen logP/MR and TPSA, fraction sp3. Compute via mol.GetSubstructMatches with Chem.MolFromSmarts patterns compiled once.
backlog.title: Domain-informed substructure counts

backlog.spec: Tune SVR with an internal 3-fold CV inside fit_predict over C in {1,3,10} and epsilon in {0.05,0.1,0.2} on the precomputed Tanimoto kernel (rank target), selecting by Spearman, then refit with the best. Use the tuned model in the ensemble.
backlog.title: Lower-capacity regularized SVR tuning

backlog.spec: Replace the single RF by an average of 4 RFs, each trained on a different random 50% subset of the feature columns (seeded) of the descriptor+Morgan count matrix, with 300 trees and max_features=0.3, min_samples_leaf=2. Average their predictions as the RF member.
backlog.title: Large-kernel RF on descriptors with random-subspace bagging

backlog.spec: After the initial ensemble prediction on test_smiles, take the 30% most extreme test predictions (top and bottom 15% by rank), add them as pseudo-labeled samples (their rank-normalized values as targets) to the training set, refit the three models once, and output the new ensemble rank average. Features computed once for train+test.
backlog.title: Pseudo-label self-training with test molecules

incumbent.description: Convert train_y to normalized ranks before fitting all three models (RF, LightGBM, SVR).

memo:
Helped: the rank-average ensemble of RF, LightGBM and Tanimoto SVR (slot 0, 0.5505, -0.0598); RF on RDKit descriptors plus Morgan counts (slot 3, 0.5272, -0.0232); rank-transforming train_y for all models (slot 6, 0.5027, -0.0246, incumbent). Gains came from descriptors, the target transform and ensemble diversity.

Did not help beyond noise (sd about 0.0070): RF and feature tweaks (bit filtering, atom-pair/torsion, ExtraTrees, bigger RF, EState, kernel PCA, descriptors only at 0.5010), bagged huber LGBM, stacking weights (0.5015), multi-radius kernels (0.5023). Fourth members XGBoost (0.4960), kernel ridge (0.5038) and descriptor LGBM (+0.0017) failed. CatBoost (0.4895/0.5051) and MLP (0.4899, then a crash) are noisy and unresolved.

Next: stop RF and feature tweaks. Rerun the MLP once, since 0.4899 was the best score seen. Retry CatBoost once. Try descriptor-based kernels and simple weight tuning. Accept only gains above about 0.01 or confirmed by replicates.
